## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

*Kusalattika, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 17.1) is a text within the Paṭṭhāna of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka. It comprises the first combination of triads (*tika*), pairing the Wholesome Triad (*kusalattika*) with the Feeling Triad (*vedanāttika*) [Nyanatiloka 2007]. Its exposition treats conditional dependencies; in its opening chapter on being dependent (*paṭicca-vāra*), it analyzes formulations such as how, dependent on a wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, a corresponding phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling arises conditioned by way of root [Nyanatiloka 2007].
